comments.enabled: Set to true to enable email notifications for bookings
comments.to: Email address that receives booking notifications
comments.from: Sender email address shown in the From field
comments.smtp: SMTP server credentials (get from your email provider)

comments.port: SMTP port (587 for TLS, 465 for SSL)
comments.secure: true for SSL (port 465), false for TLS (port 587)
comments.gmail_note: For Gmail, use an App Password (not your regular password). See setup_guide below.

2. Or use any SMTP service (SendGrid, Mailgun, etc.)
3. Fill in host, port, secure, user, password
